HTML5 Boilerplate is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2019.

What it was for: [Web](@/projects/web.md) (2).

Most recently: [nestravenkam](@/work/nestravenkam.md): Stravenky; [annasabatova.cz](@/work/annasabatova-cz.md): Petice za odvolani annysabatove.cz.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses HTML5 Boilerplate: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links HTML5 Boilerplate to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
